annotations.title: Remove a live chat staff member

description:
IRREVERSIBLE: Remove a live chat staff member

Deletes one live chat staff member for good: the person can no longer sign in to your live chat and gets no more chats. To only stop new chats for a while, set them offline with `set_live_chat_agent_status` instead. Adding them again is only possible in the dashboard or with `POST /team/live-chat-agents`. `agentId` comes from `list_live_chat_agents`. Only the account owner can call this; 404 when the staff member is not yours.

confirm.description: Leave out on the first call. EchoCall then answers with a confirmation value. Ask the user for a clear yes, then repeat the call with the same arguments and this value.
